defect: D5 — Qwen snapshot not resolved by from_pretrained
root_cause: The Qwen snapshot was downloaded with an explicit revision, so the hub cache contains the snapshot but no refs/ entry; a repository-id lookup with local_files_only=True cannot resolve it and raises OSError.
The Gate had also redirected HF_HOME to the new v3 cache, which hid the v2 verified GPT-2 cache used as the default backbone by CALF and TimeCMA, so all three LLM branches failed, not only Qwen.

repair.patched: _FrozenTextModel.__init__ now resolves the source through assets.resolve_pretrained_source(model_id) and records pretrained_source / loader_kwargs / asset for provenance.
repair.policy: verified local snapshot path, local_files_only=True, trust_remote_code=False; gpt2 and other ids pass through unchanged.
repair.d3_guard: descriptor_for('gpt2') returns None; resolve_pretrained_source('gpt2') returns ('gpt2', {'local_files_only': True}) with no revision or snapshot arguments, so the D3 defect cannot be reintroduced.

remaining_gate_script_defects.detail: the gate never calls QwenTimeLLM.set_train_statistics(...) before the forward pass, so forward raises 'train-only Prompt-as-Prefix statistics were not set'. This is a gate-harness omission; the runtime contract correctly enforces train-only statistics.
the gate passed model_id=Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B to every LLM branch; CALFInspired and TimeCMAInspired accept model_id and therefore had their preregistered gpt2 default overridden. They must run on gpt2.
